name: mild_cold_forecast_window_open_pauses_1211
description: Mild day whose forecast (high 65 / low 49) never reaches the 70 F comfort floor, so the real classifier does NOT recommend windows (the scenario states no windows_recommended: the harness fills it from classify_day). Whole-house fan configured, but the house is cool (indoor 69, below the 70 floor) so nat-vent is refused. A window opens at 12:00 inside the static 10:00-17:00 period: the handler pauses right there, never a silent no-op (Issue #1211, three-exercise scenario from the evaluation report).
source: Issue #1211 pending scenario (promote only with owner review)
notes: Issue #1211: classifier-driven classification (high 65 / low 49 -> windows_recommended False; times still set 10:00/17:00). Window open inside the static period.

Three-exercise protocol: (a) effectiveness: with the A3 handler change reverted this still pauses (the refresh-free engine run returns silently then and the 12:00 assertion fails); with the old always-True mild rule the harness would hand the engine an exemption that no longer matters to the handler, so this scenario guards the handler, not the classifier; (b) docs: docs/08 C2/C5 rows say the open window pauses when the gate refuses; (c) occupant: if it regressed the HVAC would keep heating into an open window until the next refresh.

events.note: Late morning: indoor 69F (below the 70F floor), outdoor 60F
Mild day, forecast high 65 / low 49: the real classifier decides (no windows recommended)
Window opens at 12:00 inside the static period; nat-vent gate refuses (indoor below the floor) -> pause

assertions.reason: Window left open, nat-vent refused (indoor 69 < floor 70): the handler pauses (Issue #1211).

verdict.summary: A window opened on a mild day whose forecast never reaches the floor pauses the HVAC; no silent no-op
